text.finding: On the 239 Addis filters (time-blocked folds) the HIPS/10 − f(X) relation is b = 0.802·f(X) + 2.851, so the residual carries 0.198·f(X) by construction. A learner given only f(X) reaches residual R² 0.064, inside the no-information null (median 0.077, p = 0.67); the spectra learner reaches 0.244, above the null's q95 0.113 (ftir_43). Paired against f(X) + season + volume + lot on the same blocks, the spectra gain ΔRMSE -0.060 µg/m³ [-0.134, +0.020] is not significant (it does beat the null: q95 +0.031); with gravimetric mass in the base it becomes -0.126 [-0.199, -0.032] (ftir_46). No named feature carries the increment (ftir_45). At fixed f(X) and season the residual falls -0.068 µg/m³ per µg/m³ of mass [-0.097, -0.045]: the lead is loading, and the mass term is two to three times larger at the Ethiopian sites than elsewhere.

model: M2c + neutral bands (1617, O–H, CH, C=O)
